confirmed_task:
Go to the GitHub repository for Microsoft Playwright at https://github.com/microsoft/playwright. Open the Releases page and identify the newest non-preview release. Report its release tag, publication date, and three changes from the release notes. Verify one of those changes using the official Playwright documentation.

Stopping condition: Stop after the release metadata, three release-note changes, and one documentation verification have been recorded.

Constraints:
- Do not sign in.
- Do not create issues, comments, pull requests, or file changes.

items.criterion: Access Playwright GitHub Releases page (or reasonable official fallback) without signing in
items.description: Agent attempts to access https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/releases (no sign-in) and navigate/locate the releases list. Full credit if the agent makes a reasonable attempt but is blocked (e.g., outage, CAPTCHA, rate limit) and clearly reports the blocker and a reasonable fallback attempt (e.g., direct /releases URL refresh, GitHub tags/releases API endpoints, or another official GitHub view). Partial credit if the attempt is unclear or on the wrong repo before correcting. No credit if no meaningful attempt is made or a different repository is used throughout.

From the accessible releases information, correctly identifies the newest release that is not marked as preview/pre-release. Full credit if the correct latest stable release is selected OR if the agent cannot determine this due to access/UI limitations but explicitly states the ambiguity/blocker and what was tried. Partial credit if it selects a pre-release despite visible evidence of a newer stable release. No credit if the selection is unrelated or fabricated.

items.criterion: Record release metadata (tag and publication date) for the identified stable release
items.description: Reports the release tag and publication date as shown in the official source used (GitHub release page/API or equivalent official listing). Full credit for both correct when accessible. If access to the metadata is blocked/unavailable after reasonable attempts, full credit if the agent explicitly reports inability to retrieve the tag/date (without guessing) and cites what prevented retrieval. Partial credit if only one of tag/date is provided correctly or if the date is imprecise but clearly sourced.

items.criterion: Extract three distinct changes from the release notes of that stable release
items.description: Lists three distinct, specific changes that are clearly attributable to the release notes of the identified newest stable release. Full credit if three accurate changes are provided when notes are accessible. If release notes are inaccessible/truncated due to external issues, full credit if the agent documents the blocker and provides fewer/no changes rather than inventing content. Partial credit for only 1–2 correct changes, or if changes are too vague but plausibly tied to the notes.

items.criterion: Verify one of the listed changes using official Playwright documentation
items.description: Uses official Playwright documentation (playwright.dev) to substantiate one of the three listed changes (e.g., a documented API/option/behavior matching the release note). Full credit if the verification is clearly linked to the same change and is supported by the docs. If playwright.dev is blocked/unavailable after reasonable attempts, full credit if the agent reports the blocker and does not fabricate verification. Partial credit if the agent references docs but they do not actually support the claimed change, or if a non-official source is used despite official docs being accessible.

items.criterion: Comply with constraints and stopping condition
items.description: Does not sign in and does not create issues/comments/PRs/file changes. Stops after providing release metadata, three release-note changes, and one documentation verification (allowing brief context about blockers/attempts). Full credit if constraints are respected. Partial credit if minor extra output beyond the stopping condition but constraints are still respected. No credit if prohibited actions are taken.
